objective.name: test.open_gate
objective.description: Test tool: opens a named gate.

#root.role: Add the named gate to the open gates of the gates matter.

transformation_contract.morphing: A gate name becomes an open gate.
invariants: Opening an already open gate is an idempotent success.
success: The gate is open and every waiting test.slow call may answer.
notes: Executed by the test_tools Python wrapper. Test infrastructure only: it carries no business logic and exists to exercise the agentic mechanics.

effects.gates: The named gate is added to the open list, idempotently.
